name: vertex-certification
description: Vertex Certification marketing website - static HTML, Tailwind CSS and vanilla JS

scripts.build: node scripts/build-schemes.mjs && tailwindcss -i ./styles/tailwind.css -o ./assets/css/styles.css --minify && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R *.html .htaccess assets schemes dist/
scripts.bundle: pnpm build && rm -f vertex-site.zip && cd dist && zip -rq ../vertex-site.zip . -x "*.DS_Store"
